decisions.reason: This cleaning soap is highly complementary to the firm’s flooring systems, draws directly on its existing care and technical knowledge, and its move to a dedicated web page in 2024 suggests solid enough market acceptance to continue learning and scaling.

The maintenance oil line fits the firm’s established wood-floor maintenance capabilities and customer base, and although its web presence did not deepen in 2024, the firm’s in-house R&D and installer feedback should make improvement easier than abandonment.

This care product for oiled floors is closely tied to the firm’s core flooring expertise, and the stronger standalone presentation in 2024 indicates that the firm is successfully assimilating market feedback and sees commercial value in keeping it.

Moisture-protection underlay is an adjacent system accessory that the firm can support through its installation know-how and channel relationships, so despite only modest web visibility it is still more likely to be retained than dropped.

High-density underlay foam is somewhat less central to the firm’s distinctive wood-processing knowledge and may face portfolio overlap, but it still supports the system offer and remains likely to stay while the firm tests where it adds value.

The oak parquet line is closest to the firm’s core manufacturing, sourcing, design, and sales capabilities, so absorptive capacity is strongest here and there is little reason to remove it after surviving its first full year on the market.
